boundary_note: Current map has LA City and LA County approximate study rectangles. Neither is an authoritative metropolitan boundary, and the present pilot does not establish full metropolitan coverage.
existing_work_note: Already implemented source adapters and map controls are documented below. This record does not certify processing of the specimen queue or create downstream tasks.

ACS median household income is wired for LA County tracts; not wealth, and live Census browser QA remains pending.
LA County assessor parcel geometry is browser verified; a wider metropolitan-area jurisdiction audit remains pending.
The County provider exposes source roll years and assessed land/improvement values. Not sale prices or current market valuation.
